sentences.text: Deep, deep below, the ocean was as black as ink.
No sunlight could reach this world.
"Look there!"
Captain Kira pointed.
A tiny golden light moved through the sea snow.
Beside her, Toby the young diver pressed his face to the glass.
"It's moving!"
The Aurora submarine turned toward the strange light.
It followed the light into the dark canyon.
It was an anglerfish, the queen of the deep.
But her magic lamp was fading.
A thick plastic bag covered her head.
It dimmed her glowing light.
The fish bumped into rocks.
She was lost and hungry because of all the drifting waste.
Suddenly, a strong current pulled the fish.
She was heading toward a jagged cave!
"We must act now!"
Captain Kira cried.
Diver Toby opened the submarine's silver robot arms.
The submarine shook in the wild water.
"Hold on!"
Toby said.
Kira held the wheel tight.
The robot arm moved like a dancer.
It reached out and caught the edge of the bag.
With a soft tug, the plastic bag came off.
The machine collected the dangerous waste.
Instantly, the fish's lamp shone like a star.
The darkness faded away in a golden glow.
The anglerfish wiggled her fins.
She looked at the submarine as if saying, "Thank you."
"Her light is back," Kira whispered.
Toby smiled at the glowing sea.
The Aurora moved on to the next job.
One small light was enough to light the way.

principles: Story Grammar structures what is assessed but is not treated as the sole model of reading comprehension.
Scores reflect evidence of Story Element and relationship understanding, not lexical or semantic similarity alone.
100/67/33/0 are operational reporting values; they are not empirically calibrated IRT ability estimates.
Overall feedback must be combined with the lowest skill profile and selected misconception.
